headline: Sustained gold loan growth and NIM expansion drive earnings beat

PAT in 2QFY27 rose ~220% YoY and 20% QoQ to ~INR7b in 2QFY27 (~6% beat).

Annualized credit costs rose ~30bp QoQ to 1.6% (PQ: ~1.35%).  The company reported a ~6% QoQ growth in consolidated gold AUM to ~INR606b, with management indicating healthy momentum in loan growth, customer additions, and gold tonnage growth.
The company reiterated its FY27 gold loan growth guidance of 30%.
valuation: Valuation and view  MGFL delivered a steady performance, supported by sustained growth in the gold loan portfolio and improved yields, driving margin expansion.

Work on another ~250 branches is underway, with openings expected over the next couple of months.  Management remains confident of sustaining growth while maintaining prudent LTVs, gold valuation practices, and robust custody standards.
